areas.title: Foundation models
areas.description: Efficient adaptation of vision and multimodal foundation models.

areas.title: Collaborative learning
areas.description: Federated and split learning across clients and devices.

areas.title: Reliable learning
areas.description: Learning from limited labels, label noise and shifting domains.

areas.title: Privacy & security
areas.description: Secure aggregation, federated unlearning and backdoor analysis.

mapping_notes.enccluster: Foundation-model membership includes the related NeurIPS 2024 Federated Foundation Models workshop paper; the main project page distinguishes that version from the general FL study.
mapping_notes.fedser: Classified under collaborative learning. Retaining raw speech locally alone does not establish secure aggregation or differential privacy.
mapping_notes.ae-psl: Parallel split learning belongs to decentralized learning and foundation-model adaptation; it is not federated averaging.
mapping_notes.mpsl: Multimodal parallel split learning belongs to decentralized learning and foundation-model adaptation; it is not federated averaging.
mapping_notes.decentralized: Federated and parallel split learning are distinct collaborative paradigms. PLiX and DA-MLDG are listed under reliable learning because their training is not distributed.
mapping_notes.foundation: Includes vision-only and multimodal adaptation. EncCluster includes its related federated foundation models workshop version, distinguished on its project page.
